title: Wang2016 – SSVEP Wang 2016 dataset
description: A benchmark SSVEP-based brain-computer interface dataset with EEG recordings from 34 healthy participants (35 in the original publication) who gazed at 40 flickering characters in a speller. The characters were coded with joint frequency and phase modulation (8-15.8 Hz in 0.2 Hz steps). Each participant completed 6 blocks of 40 trials with 64-channel EEG recorded at 1000 Hz and downsampled to 250 Hz. Data are provided as epochs with 0.5 s before and after each 5 s stimulation period.
methods_description: EEG was recorded with a Synamps2 system (Neuroscan) using 64 scalp channels, a 0.15-200 Hz passband, a 50 Hz notch filter, a vertex reference and impedances below 10 kΩ. Stimuli were presented on a 23.6-inch 60 Hz LCD monitor using sampled sinusoidal stimulation in a 5x8 matrix. Each trial began with a 0.5 s cue, followed by 5 s of flicker and a 0.5 s blank. Continuous data were epoched around stimulus onsets and downsampled from 1000 to 250 Hz without digital filtering.
